input.quote: 14.9 Bankruptcy. The parties hereto agree that Corio, as a licensee of Commerce One's intellectual property, shall be afforded all of the protections afforded to a licensee under Section 365(n) of the United States Bankruptcy Code
input.rationale: The only occurrence of "insurance" in the document is in the definition of net revenue (p0012, a pricing deduction), and Miscellaneous (§ 14.1–14.10) contains no insurance covenant. Commerce One licenses hosted software, provides the MarketSite Service and support contacts, so a standard insurance covenant is expected. We insert the fallback position only (E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000), which is the shortest complete change; we did not volunteer the preferred CGL, workers' compensation or certificate mechanics.

proposal.summary: Insert short vendor insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber/privacy USD 2M) in Miscellaneous
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though Commerce One's software and MarketSite Service touch our data and personnel. We added our fallback position: errors and omissions cover of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy cover of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
